company.introduction: Centrica supplies energy and related services to households and businesses, with British Gas a central UK brand and Bord Gais Energy serving Ireland. Its activities include electricity and gas supply, boiler installation and maintenance, energy trading and other energy assets and solutions. Revenue comes from customer bills, service agreements and wholesale activities. Retail supply requires balancing energy purchases with customer consumption, while service operations depend on skilled engineers and reliable scheduling. The different businesses respond differently to wholesale prices and weather. Regulation, customer service, credit management and the ability to manage volatile energy markets are important to the group's operational and financial performance.
